description.en: An advanced, UI-powered AI second brain Agent Skill for OpenClaw, Hermes Agent, WorkBuddy, TRAE, and QClaw. ZhiGui uses long-term memory to help you make better decisions, automatically plan tomorrow, resolve conflicting notes, and deliver each day's plan through your existing agent channels.
description.zh: 基于 UI 的 AI 第二大脑技能，利用长期记忆辅助决策和规划。

audience.zh: AI 助手用户/知识管理爱好者
audience.en: AI assistant users and knowledge management enthusiasts

usecases.zh: 利用长期记忆辅助决策、自动规划明日、解决笔记冲突
usecases.en: Use long-term memory for decisions, auto-plan tomorrow, resolve conflicting notes
